Agent Name: DataVerification_Expert
, Step Number: 4
, Reason for Mistake: They switched to a requests + BeautifulSoup scraper on a JavaScript-rendered OpenReview page and assumed the target elements (note/title/authors/recommendation) would be present in the static HTML. This produced an empty dataset saved to CSV without validation, leading to the subsequent EmptyDataError and preventing the correct count from being obtained. They also failed to use the OpenReview API or otherwise verify the extraction before proceeding.
